# Vendor sources — licence and source-offer inputs

This file is the human-readable source-offer record for the pinned vendor set in
[`../vendor.lock.json`](../vendor.lock.json). The licence generator
(`packaging/licenses/`, `SOURCE_OFFER.md`, and `scripts/fetch_sources.py`)
consumes these inputs; it must not re-derive them from the binaries.

Every archive below is downloaded over HTTPS, verified against the recorded
SHA-256 by `scripts/vendor-fetch.sh` / `scripts/vendor-fetch.ps1`, and never
committed. The source-built components are built from the exact archive and
configure line recorded in the lock.

## Written offer

StemForge offers, under GPL-3.0-only section 6(b), the complete corresponding
source for every GPL-licensed binary it ships. This written offer is valid for
**three years** from the release date and is fulfilled from the release page.
Send requests to <https://github.com/alexmarincu/stemforge/issues>.

Release page: <https://github.com/alexmarincu/stemforge/releases>.

Archive URLs are recorded once in the lock. The source-built components:

- `rubberband` — tag `v4.0.0`, commit
  `1d95888bec3ae0a17c0c4af791810d5a63f6bc35`; built with builtin FFT and
  resampler, static `librubberband`, CLI only. The shipped
  `ffmpeg -buildconf`-equivalent record is generated by the vendor script into
  `vendor/PROVENANCE.txt`; `LICENSES/rubberband/BUILDINFO.txt` gets the same
  configure line in the licence tree.
- `libsndfile` — tag `1.2.2`; built as a shared WAV-only library with external
  codecs and MPEG disabled. `libsndfile.so.1` / `sndfile.dll` ships beside the
  Rubber Band CLI, so the LGPL relink right is preserved by replacing that file.

## FFmpeg corresponding source

The BtbN build is GPLv3 static. The corresponding-source bundle must include:

- the FFmpeg source at the version commit `gd838f9f9ae` and every external
  library named by the shipped `ffmpeg -buildconf` at its `SCRIPT_COMMIT`;
- BtbN's build scripts at tag `autobuild-2026-11-15-12-40`;
- the exact configure line captured from `ffmpeg -buildconf` into
  `LICENSES/ffmpeg/BUILDINFO.txt` by the release job.

## No weights

This record contains no model weights and no Hugging Face URL. `htdemucs`
weights stay outside the vendor set and outside every artifact (ADR 0009).
